qualification.public_summary: Alpha 0.0.89 / B190 development passed software validation and five bounded NTSC DV captures on one Sony HVR-M15U setup, including normal capture STOP, same-session re-entry, fresh-app re-entry, about sixty seconds and a four-minute operator-stopped capture job. This does not establish fresh-system installation or hardware qualification of the separately packaged ad-hoc binary. Full-tape completion, broader hardware and formats remain unqualified.
